about.title: .jhun{}
about.heading: Who We Are
about.lead: .jhun is a passionate team dedicated to creating innovative solutions that help businesses grow and succeed in the digital age.
about.paragraph1_text: Creativity and technology meet in the digital world. At .jhun we see web development not just as a tool but as an art form. We accelerate digital transformation, strengthen user experience, and help brands stand out online.
about.mission_text: Deliver innovative and effective web solutions, build fast, secure and scalable infrastructures using modern technologies, design user-centered interfaces and experiences, and maximize brands' digital potential.
about.vision_text: At .jhun we aim to design the web experiences of the future and keep brands at the forefront in a constantly changing tech world. Creating a difference in digital means catching not only today's but tomorrow's trends. With every project we deliver user-focused, innovative and aesthetic solutions. We don't just build functional websites and apps; we create experiences that strengthen brands' digital strategies, boost engagement and conversion. Turning technology into strategic advantage, ensuring top-level data security and building high-performance infrastructures are the cornerstones of our vision.
about.projects_description: We provide businesses with modern, user-friendly and effective web solutions. From design to SEO optimization, from blog management to e-commerce integration, we support digital growth in every step.
about.logo_title: Where does our logo come from?
about.logo_paragraph1: .jhun comes from our founder Ceyhun Turkmen's name and makes a playful nod to JSON format: the dot suggests objects and the curly braces represent data blocks. The name and the logo reflect our modern, minimal and tech-focused identity both visually and conceptually.
about.logo_paragraph2: The navy color symbolizes the night sky's infinity in web design. The navy in the .jhun logo represents the inspiring order of stars and our brand's boundless creativity — dedicated to a professional and trustworthy identity.
about.quote: Minimalist design and the symbols of the code world directly communicate our brand's innovative and solution-oriented approach to visitors.
about.achievement_sub: We provide tools that improve workflows, increase efficiency, and encourage growth for businesses.

items.title: Web Design & Development
items.description: I build fast, scalable and SEO-friendly corporate websites and e-commerce platforms with React, Next.js and TypeScript.
items.detail: Responsive design, page speed optimization, accessibility and component-based architecture come first — every project is built from scratch with code quality and maintainability in mind.

items.title: SEO Optimization
items.description: I improve your site's visibility in search engines through technical SEO, page speed and content structure improvements.
items.detail: Sitemaps, structured data (schema.org), meta tag strategy and Core Web Vitals improvements help grow your organic traffic in a measurable way.

items.title: E-Commerce Solutions
items.description: I build custom end-to-end e-commerce platforms with payment integration, shipment tracking and admin panels.
items.detail: I seamlessly integrate payment providers like iyzico alongside admin panels covering cart, coupons, variant tracking and order management.

items.title: API & Backend Development
items.description: I design secure, scalable REST APIs and database architectures with Node.js, .NET and Prisma ORM.
items.detail: I build production-ready backend systems covering authentication, authorization, rate limiting and database performance optimization.

items.title: Digital Consulting
items.description: I provide consulting on technology choices, architecture decisions and performance optimization.
items.detail: I review your existing system, identify bottlenecks, and together we map out the most suitable technology roadmap for scalability and cost.

items.title: Maintenance & Support
items.description: I offer ongoing maintenance, updates and technical support for your launched projects.
items.detail: Security patches, dependency updates and performance monitoring keep your project running smoothly long after launch.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: The most common questions about process, pricing and collaboration.

items.question: How long does a project take?
items.answer: Timeline depends on scope; a simple corporate site can be delivered in 2-3 weeks, while a full e-commerce platform takes 6-10 weeks. I provide a clear timeline during the discovery phase.

items.question: How is pricing determined?
items.answer: Every project is priced individually based on scope, feature count and integrations. I prepare a detailed quote once you share your requirements.

items.question: What technologies do you work with?
items.answer: Mainly React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, .NET and PostgreSQL/MySQL; I can also integrate other tools as needed.

items.question: Do you provide support after launch?
items.answer: Yes, I offer maintenance and technical support packages for all launched projects.

items.question: Do you redesign existing sites or only build from scratch?
items.answer: I work on both new builds and redesigns/modernizations of existing sites.

items.question: Is remote work possible?
items.answer: Yes, based in Uşak, I work fully remotely with clients across Turkey and internationally.

technologiesIntro.p1: This project was developed using the best tools modern web technologies offer. Each technology was carefully selected to maximize performance, security, and user experience. During development, we focused on component-based architecture, reusable code, and optimized rendering performance.
technologiesIntro.p2: The user interface was designed to provide a clean yet impactful visual experience. The design system is built on principles of consistency, readability, and accessibility. Modern CSS frameworks and utility tools were used to provide a strong styling foundation.
technologiesIntro.p3: On the frontend, powerful technologies like React and Next.js provided great advantages in terms of fast load times and SEO optimization. Additionally, Tailwind CSS accelerated the design process and made development more flexible.
technologiesIntro.p4: As a result, this technology stack forms a modern and sustainable infrastructure that supports not only today’s needs but also future scalability goals.
technologiesIntro.p5: The project also delivers a seamless experience across all devices thanks to responsive design and a mobile-first approach. Every aspect of the design was optimized for usability and accessibility, ensuring smooth user interactions.
technologiesIntro.p6: Performance optimizations were implemented to minimize page load times, including efficient media and image handling. This approach improves user experience while providing a solid foundation for SEO and overall site performance.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how personal data collected through jhun.com.tr ('Site') is processed under Turkey's Law on the Protection of Personal Data (KVKK No. 6698). The data controller is Ceyhun Türkmen.

sections.heading: 1. Data We Collect
sections.body: Through the contact form, we collect your name, email address and message content. Technical data such as browser type, IP address and cookies may be collected automatically while using the site.

sections.heading: 2. Purpose of Processing
sections.body: Collected data is processed to respond to your request, communicate with you, and ensure the technical performance and security of the site.

sections.heading: 3. Retention Period
sections.body: Data submitted via the contact form is retained for as long as necessary to resolve your request and is deleted once legal retention periods expire.

sections.heading: 4. Cookies
sections.body: The site may use essential and preference-based cookies to improve your experience. You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings.

sections.heading: 5. Sharing With Third Parties
sections.body: Your personal data is not shared with or sold to third parties except where legally required.

sections.heading: 6. Your Rights
sections.body: Under Article 11 of KVKK, you have the right to access, correct, delete and object to the processing of your data. You can exercise these rights by contacting us via the email address on the contact page.
